defects.claim: Flag 'torso_forward'. globalTilt=25 leans whole body forward (toward prone per corrected convention + = toward prone). Description: 'arch the back' (back-arch, not forward tilt). The 'lean upper body slightly forward' should be via spine articulation, not whole-body globalTilt. Set globalTilt=0; use spine for arch.
defects.evidence: geometry.json: torso flexion_deg=-7 (slight back arch from spine=-32), but globalTilt=25 produces additional 25° forward body lean — overall body leaning forward triggering flag.

defects.claim: Description doesn't mention lateral tilt. globalRoll=15 tilts body sideways. Set to 0.
Description doesn't mention axial twist. globalTwist=20 twists torso. Set to 0.
Description: 'tilt the face toward the camera' = yaw, not roll. neck=-11 tilts head LEFT per corrected convention. Should be 0 (no side tilt; yaw not modeled).
defects.evidence: geometry.json: head roll_deg=-26.3 (left tilt, exaggerated by globalRoll).

defects.claim: Description: 'Bend both arms' (implies symmetric). leftShoulder=-70 vs rightShoulder=-65 (5° asymmetry); shoulderFwdL=-30 vs shoulderFwdR=-20 (10° asymmetry); leftElbow=55 vs rightElbow=58 (3° asymmetry). Make symmetric.
defects.evidence: raw joints: leftShoulder=-70, rightShoulder=-65, shoulderFwdL=-30, shoulderFwdR=-20.

rationale: Flag 'torso_forward' triggered by globalTilt=25 (whole-body forward lean). Description: 'arch the back, lean upper body slightly forward' — these are somewhat contradictory for single spine joint; prioritize 'arch the back' as primary feature (per tip 'Lift through the sternum'). (1) globalTilt 25→0 (clears torso_forward flag; arch expressed via spine only). (2) spine -32→-20 (less extreme, 'controlled and elegant' per tip). (3) globalRoll 15→0, globalTwist 20→0 (not mentioned in description). (4) neck -11→0 (no side tilt; 'face toward camera' = yaw not modeled). (5) Symmetric arms: leftShoulder -70→-65 (match right), shoulderFwdL -30→-25 (match right), leftElbow 55→56 (match right). Right arm joints unchanged. Rig limitation: 'lean forward' sacrificed (single spine joint can't do both arch + forward lean); prioritized 'arch the back' per description primary action.
